abort.already_setup: Eleven Energy is already set up.

user.title: Eleven Energy
user.description: Sign in with your Eleven Energy account, or set up with an API key.

token.title: API key
token.description: Create a key in the Eleven Energy app under Site & System Settings, Access, Add Access. Signing in is usually easier - go back to choose it.

set_work_mode_self_consumption.name: Self consumption
set_work_mode_self_consumption.description: Solar covers the house, surplus charges the battery, and once it is full the surplus is exported. The battery makes up any shortfall. This is the normal resting state.

percent_to_battery.name: Surplus to battery
percent_to_battery.description: How much of the surplus solar to store rather than export, as a percentage. Leave unset to store all of it.

set_work_mode_force_charge.name: Force charge
set_work_mode_force_charge.description: Charge the battery from the grid at a set power until it reaches a target. Once there, the house is supplied from the grid until the mode is changed.

target_power.name: Charge power
target_power.description: Battery charge power in kW. A lower rate may be used if the battery is current limited, such as at a low state of charge.

target_percent.name: Target state of charge
target_percent.description: The state of charge to stop charging at.

set_work_mode_grid_export.name: Grid export
set_work_mode_grid_export.description: Discharge the battery to the grid at a set power until it reaches a target. After that the house is still supplied from the battery, but surplus solar is exported rather than stored.

target_power.name: Discharge power
target_power.description: Battery discharge power in kW. This is battery power, not power at the meter: with 1 kW of house load, 5 kW here puts about 4 kW on the grid.

target_percent.name: Target state of charge
target_percent.description: The state of charge to stop discharging at.

include_excess_solar.name: Add surplus solar
include_excess_solar.description: Export surplus solar on top of the discharge power rather than storing it.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.description: Allow exceeding the usual export ceiling where the connection permits it. Leave off unless you have been told otherwise.

set_work_mode_pv_export.name: PV export priority
set_work_mode_pv_export.description: Like self consumption, but surplus solar is exported before it is stored. If more solar is available than can be exported, the remainder goes to the battery.

set_work_mode_idle_battery.name: Idle battery
set_work_mode_idle_battery.description: Hold the battery where it is. Charging and discharging can be allowed separately.

allow_charging.name: Allow charging
allow_charging.description: Permit charging the battery from surplus solar.

allow_discharging.name: Allow discharging
allow_discharging.description: Permit discharging the battery to supply the house.

set_work_mode_target_soc.name: Reach a state of charge
set_work_mode_target_soc.description: Reach a target state of charge within a deadline, working out the rate from the house load as it goes. Once the target is reached the system runs in PV export priority until the mode is changed.

target_soc.name: Target state of charge
target_soc.description: The state of charge to aim for.

target_minutes.name: Within
target_minutes.description: How long it has to get there, in minutes.

max_charge_power.name: Maximum charge power
max_charge_power.description: A ceiling in kW while charging. A lower rate may be used; this is only a maximum.

max_discharge_power.name: Maximum discharge power
max_discharge_power.description: A ceiling in kW while discharging. A lower rate may be used; this is only a maximum.

set_work_mode_reset.name: Hand control back
set_work_mode_reset.description: Restore the system's own operation. If a schedule was in effect when the mode was changed it resumes, otherwise automatic operation does. Send this when your automation has finished - until you do, the system's own optimisation stays switched off.

binary_sensor_renamed.title: An Eleven Energy entity has been renamed
binary_sensor_renamed.description:
The Online entity was created in the wrong category when this integration was first released: it is a binary sensor, but its entity ID began with `sensor.`. Home Assistant warns about that now and stops accepting it in version 2027.5, so it has been corrected.

**Renamed:**

{entities}

Renaming does not update references automatically. If you use this entity in an automation, script, dashboard card or template, update it to the new ID - anything still pointing at the old one will not work.

Nothing else has changed, and once you have checked you can dismiss this.
